task.question: In the 2026 FIFA World Cup, what format was used for the knockout stage starting June 28?
task.evidence: The knockout stage used a single-elimination format, starting with the newly introduced round of 32 on June 28 and culminating with the final on July 19, with a match for third place the day before. If the score was even after regulation time in a match, 30 minutes of extra time were added. If still tied after this, a penalty shootout determined the winner.
task.sonnet_answer: The Round of 32 knockout stage began on June 28, 2026, as the expanded 48-team tournament introduced a Round of 32 for the first time in World Cup history.

answer:
The knockout stage of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, starting June 28, featured a single-elimination format. The top two teams from each of the twelve groups, along with the best eight third-place teams, advanced to this stage. A total of 32 matches were played, culminating in the final at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

FINAL: Single-elimination format with 32 matches.

messages.content: [2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage] The knockout stage of the 2026 FIFA World Cup was the second and final stage of the competition, following the group stage. Played from June 28 to July 19, 2026, the knockout stage ended with the final, held at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The top two teams from each of the twelve groups, along with the best eight third-place teams, advanced to the knockout stage to compete in a single-elimination tournament. There were 32 matches in the knockout stage, including a match for third place.

messages.content: [Чемпионат мира по футболу 2026 (отборочный турнир, КАФ)] Отборочный турнир чемпионата мира по футболу 2026 в Африке проходил с 15 ноября 2023 года по 16 ноября 2025 года и определил участников финальной части ЧМ-2026 от КАФ . Формат  Исполнительный комитет CAF 19 мая 2023 года объявил новый формат квалификации. Команды были разбиты на девять групп по шесть команд. Победитель каждой группы напрямую попадает на чемпионат мира, а четыре лучшие команды, занявшие вторые места в группах, участвуют в плей-офф, чтобы определить, какая команда выйдет в межконфедеральные стыковые матчи [ 1 ] [ 2 ] . Групповой этап: Девять групп по шесть команд сыграют в круговом турнире дома и на выезде. Победители групп автоматически квалифицируются на чемпионат мира по футболу 2026 года. Стадия плей-офф: Четыре лучшие команды, занявшие вторые места в группах, выйдут в плей-офф, чтобы определить представителя КАФ в Межконтинентальных стыковых матчах. messages.content: [U.S. to host inaugural 2028 Women's Club World Cup] The inaugural Women's Club World Cup will be staged in January 2028 in the United States, FIFA said on Thursday, although host cities have not been confirmed. FIFA's Bureau of the Council also approved the distribution of $2.5 million in preparation money to each participating member association at the 2027 Women's World Cup, the same amount that teams were granted for the 2026 Men's World Cup. That is an increase from $960,000 per team in preparation funding for the 2023 Women's World Cup. FIFA also said that 2027 Women's World Cup players "will enjoy the same service levels as their male counterparts in 2026," and that surplus money would have a "specific amount ring-fenced for players." In 2023, ever player was guaranteed a minimum of $30,000 each from FIFA for their participation in the World Cup. The appointment of the first Women's Club World Cup in the United States follows the country hosting the expanded Men's Club World Cup in 2025 and the 2026 World Cup earlier this year. The U.S. will also co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup, an uncontested bid that is expected to be formally approved by FIFA next month. Miami will host the scaled-down FIFA Women's Champions Cup in January, as FIFA previously announced. Multiple reports previously stated that Los Angeles and San Diego were being considered as host cities for the 2028 Women's Club World Cup. A FIFA spokesperson declined to confirm specific cities that will host games. The 19-team event will run from January 5-30, 2028. "We undertook a detailed assessment to identify the most suitable host for the inaugural edition of the FIFA Women's Club World Cup," FIFA chief women's football officer Dame Sarai Bareman said in a statement. "Ultimately, the United States' recent excellence in staging top FIFA tournaments, combined with the significant interest in women's football there plus its elite sporting infrastructure, made the country the standout option."
